claim: The Commission may terminate a license if it determines the applicant’s lobbying certification was intentionally false or intentionally incomplete.
adjudicated_wording: The Commission reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to terminate a license if it determines that the applicant’s lobbying certification was intentionally false or intentionally incomplete.
citations: The Commission reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to terminate a License if the Commission determines that the Lobbying certification filed by the Applicant was intentionally false or intentionally incomplete.

claim: May disqualify the applicant and/or related persons or entities if required additional Background Investigation Forms are not timely filed.
citations: If the additional Background Investigation Forms are not timely filed, the Board or the Commission may determine to disqualify the Applicant and/or such persons or entities.

claim: May reject an application based on the results of background checks and suitability investigations.
citations: The Commission may reject an Application based upon the results of these background checks and suitability investigations.

claim: May reject an application, or cancel, revoke, or suspend a license, if an applicant or related party knowingly provides false or intentionally misleading information in an investigation.
adjudicated_wording: The Commission may reject an application, or cancel, revoke, or suspend a license, if an applicant or related party knowingly provides false or intentionally misleading information in connection with a Commission investigation.
citations: Each Applicant is advised that any Applicant or Related Party who knowingly provides false or intentionally misleading information in connection with any investigation by the Commission may cause the Application to be rejected, or a License to be canceled, revoked or suspended by the Commission, in the sole discretion of the Commission.

claim: Costs of purchasing, leasing, or optioning the land for the Gaming Facility, including title-related costs, must not be included in the Minimum Capital Investment calculation.
adjudicated_wording: The Board determined that 'Minimum Capital Investment' does not include costs related to purchasing, leasing, or optioning the land for the gaming facility, including costs of registering, appraising, transferring title, or obtaining title insurance for the land.
citations: The Board has determined that the “Minimum Capital Investment” shall not include those costs related to: | • The purchase or lease or optioning of land where the Gaming Facility will be located including costs relative to registering, appraising, transferring title, or obtaining title insurance for the land;

claim: Carried interest and other financing costs must not be included in the Minimum Capital Investment calculation.
adjudicated_wording: The Board determined that 'Minimum Capital Investment' does not include carried interest costs and other associated financing costs.
citations: The Board has determined that the “Minimum Capital Investment” shall not include those costs related to: | • Carried interest costs and other associated financing costs;

claim: Costs to mitigate impacts on host and nearby municipalities must not be included in the Minimum Capital Investment calculation.
adjudicated_wording: The Board determined that 'Minimum Capital Investment' does not include costs of mitigating impacts on host and nearby municipalities, whether directly attributable to a specific impact or not.
citations: The Board has determined that the “Minimum Capital Investment” shall not include those costs related to: | • Mitigating impacts on host and nearby municipalities whether directly attributable to a specific impact or not;

claim: Infrastructure costs outside the Gaming Facility site boundaries must not be included in the Minimum Capital Investment calculation, even if required by agreement with a host or nearby municipality.
adjudicated_wording: The Board determined that Minimum Capital Investment excludes costs of designing, improving, or constructing infrastructure outside the Gaming Facility site boundaries, including drainage, utilities, roads, interchanges, fill, contamination issues, sewer, stormwater, landscaping, and public transportation, whether or not those costs arise from an agreement with a host or nearby municipality.
citations: The Board has determined that the “Minimum Capital Investment” shall not include those costs related to: | • Designing, improving or constructing the infrastructure outside the property boundaries of the site of the Gaming Facility including those related to drainage, utility support, roadways, interchanges, fill and soil or groundwater or surface water contamination issues, sewer, storm water, landscaping, and public transportation whether or not such costs are the result of any agreement with a Host Municipality or nearby municipality;

claim: Must pay the licensing fee within 30 days after the award of the license.
adjudicated_wording: A licensee must pay the licensing fee within 30 days after the award of the license.
citations: PML Section 1321-e(3) states that the Board shall determine a licensing fee to be paid by a licensee within 30 days after the award of the license.

claim: For additional casino licenses, the Commission will set the gross-gaming-revenue tax rate through the competitive bidding process, subject to minimum rates of 25% on slot machines and 10% on all other sources.
adjudicated_wording: For additional casino licenses, the Commission will determine the gross gaming revenue tax rate through the competitive bidding process, with a minimum tax rate of 25% on slot machines and 10% on all other sources.
citations: For a Gaming Facility licensed for one of the additional casino licenses (Title 2-A), the tax rate imposed on gross gaming revenues shall be determined by the Commission pursuant to the competitive bidding process specified in this RFA. | However, the tax rate from slot machines shall be no less than 25 percent and the tax rate on all other sources shall be no less than 10 percent.

citations: All meetings and public hearings of the CAC will be subject to the New York State Open Meetings Law.
